Eight Labourers Dead, Dozens Injured in Madhya Pradesh Road Accident

A road accident in Bhind district of Madhya Pradesh resulted in the deaths of eight labourers and injuries to 32 others. The incident occurred when a pickup vehicle carrying labourers collided with a truck. One report states the pickup lost control while attempting to avoid cattle before the collision.
